title: Frontend application shell, design system and dashboards
objective: Lightweight design system and AppShell (sidebar, top nav, breadcrumbs, command palette, user menu, notifications, responsive mobile nav); dashboard primitives (metric cards, charts, tables with sort/filter/pagination, date ranges, search, empty/error/loading states, realtime indicator, activity feed); functional pages for auth, dashboard, account, org and admin routes using generated typed API bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed route renders real data from the backend in E2E tests
Keyboard navigation, labels, focus management and axe accessibility checks pass
Bundle stays within the recorded budget
